[SWS_UCM_01107] UCM Master provides progress information to Ve- hicle Driver
⌈
UCM Master shall provide to Vehicle Driver Interface Adaptive Ap-
plication methods GetSwTransferProgress and GetSwProcessProgress in
order for UCM Master to inform progress of respectively update campaign’s transfer
and processing.
⌋
